direct_helper.disposition: completed/failed callbacks occur after native.show has returned; the helper does not request an inner app.ExitMainLoop.

findings.mechanism: abort ends the active modal then immediately calls gui.ExitMainLoop. After form.show returns, only the no-failure branch exits the outer loop. guarded suppresses later callbacks, including the watchdog, once failures is set.
findings.finding: A failure during the Search Center modal has no guaranteed outer-loop exit after unwind.

findings.mechanism: abort ends the active dialog then immediately calls gui.ExitMainLoop. Both ShowModal callers return on failures. An earlier assertion can reach a later watchdog, but a watchdog firing while the modal is active has no subsequent guaranteed outer exit.
findings.finding: Source-only deadline/failure cleanup risk; normal success exits after the modal returns.

findings.mechanism: fail ends modal dialogs then immediately calls gui.ExitMainLoop. Later guarded callbacks stop on failures, and the 60-second watchdog invokes the same fail path. The direct RIS ShowModal caller returns on failure.
findings.finding: Source-only deadline/failure cleanup risk; no second Basic-style success-path inner exit was found.

findings.mechanism: abort ends the active dialog then immediately calls gui.ExitMainLoop. Each modal-return path continues or exits only when failures is empty. The 70-second watchdog invokes this same abort.
findings.finding: Source-only deadline/failure cleanup risk; successful completion exits after search_saved_research returns.

findings.mechanism: stop ends modal dialogs and posts CallAfter(gui.ExitMainLoop) while still in the modal callback. The queued exit is not explicitly owned by the return of the modal invocation.
findings.finding: Related queued failure-only risk. This source review does not prove that the queued callback executes before unwind or that this probe hangs.

limits: No probes, application files, tests, workflows, counters, time bounds or refs were changed.

All twenty direct probe blobs and the single helper were independently read and matched to the immutable d4ea tree.
The current 424cc main skipped all selected steps after Basic failed. Separate auxiliary outcomes use other native probe files and are not transferred as coverage of these failure paths.
Historical native results remain attached to their original source heads; this audit neither invalidates nor transfers them.
Existing per-step workflow bounds remain three or four minutes. A stuck or failed step cannot yield accepted PASS; the audit introduces no new release gate.
